result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears mostly well-structured, but there are a few minor visual issues related to text truncation and inconsistent styling.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated/cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontally scrollable cards show consistent spacing or add proper padding so partial cards do not appear as broken text truncation.

issues.description: The placeholder text in the search bar reads 'Restarants' which is a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons appear inconsistent — one is a white outline over the ramen image and the other is a dark/filled circle over the pizza image, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon styling and background treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The 'Healthy' category chip at the right edge appears partially cut off, indicating the category row is horizontally scrollable but lacks a visual affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade or partial visibility of the next chip to clearly indicate horizontal scrollability.
